t: Shello lehapsiq lo beg' rishonot velo beg' acharonot
s: Shello lehapsiq lo beg' rishonot velo beg' acharonot ubo seip echad: q"k zeqenim umehem kamma nebiim tiqqenu y"ch berakot al hasseder, g' rishonot lehasdir shibcho shel maqom techilla keebed shemmesadder shibcho shel rabbo techilla veachar kak mebaqqesh peras merabbo, veg' acharonot hen keebed sheqqibbel peras merabbo veniptar veholek lo, vey"g haemtzaiyyot hen baqqashat peras. Lepikak im ratza hayyachid lishol tzerakayv bibrakot haemtzaiyyot — rashshay, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qy"t. Abal beg' rishonot veg' acharonot shehen siddur shebach — en lishol bah tzorke yachid. Abal tzorke tzibbur muttar, shehare "aboda" ve"sim shalom" baqqashat tzorke rabbim hen, veim mah shehaebed mesadder shibcho shel rabbo yakol lishol tzorke tzibbur, shezzehu gam ken shebach vekabod leharab sherabbim tzerikim lo. Veal ken nahagu bimdinot ellu lomar qrvb"tz beg' rishonot veg' acharonot ap al pi sheyyesh bahen kamma baqqashot, vegam en bahem mishshum hepseq battepilla apillu lehaomerim sheasur lehapsiq bepiyyutim bebirkot qeriat shema, kemo shennitbaer besiman s"ch:
